{{Quote|Soon you will see an entire Republic fleet disappear, thanks to the Silencer.|[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron|Pyron]]|<ref name="Testing" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]], the '''testing''' of the new [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer superweapon]] occurred in the middle of a space battle between [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and a lone [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] dreadnought.

==Prelude==
During the [[Galactic War]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron]] dreamed of completing the project [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]], a megalaser that could destroy entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]]. When the project was cancelled by [[Darth Thanaton]] who was obssessed with the supermacy of [[the Force]], Pyron decided to seek new allies and contacted Thanaton's nemesis [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]. Pyron asked Kallig to obtain the [[CN-12 sensor chip]] required to complete the project, which the Sith Lord did through their contacts on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. After thanking his new ally, Pyron promised to finbish the project, which would aid in Kallig's struggle against Thanaton.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Building a Power Base|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

When the Silencer was complete, the superlaser was mounted onto the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Doombringer]]''. Pyron invited Kallig to attend its first testing, for which his fellow Moffs [[Dolus]] and [[Graham]] and various other Imperial officers would also bear witness. Kallig arrived at the ''Doombringer'' aboard his [[Darth Nox's Fury-class Imperial interceptor|personal ship]] and the ''Doombringer'' jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Testing" />

==The Battle==
{{Quote|We're here today to demonstrate a new weapon, code name "Silencer."|Moff Pyron|<ref name="Testing" />}}
Pyron explained to those gathered that the plan was to use the Silencer on a small [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet. But when they emerged out of hyperspace, they found their intended target engaged in a battle against a lone Imperial warship. As the Silencer was prepared to fire, the ''Doombringer'' received a distress call, identifying the other ship as [[Darth Achelon]]'s ''[[Carnage]]'' and requesting immediate assistance. The matter was complicated by Achelon being an ally of Thanaton and his ship being in the Silencer's blast range. Moff [[Graham]] wanted to fire the Silencer anyway, letting Achelon burn in an act of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Moff Pyron warned that the Republic ships would destroy the ''Carnage'' regardless and that joining them or not using the Silencer would spell their own doom as well. Ultimately, the decision fell to Kallig as the only Sith present and thus the highest authority. The Silencer was fired and the entire Republic force present was obliterated.<ref name="Testing" />

==Aftermath==
The Moffs were impressed by the display of the Silencer's power and pledged themselves into an alliance with Kallig. In return, Kallig instructed Pyron to provide a Silencer for each of the Moff's capital ships. Kallig then departed to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the site of their [[Kaggath (Galactic War)|Kaggath]] against Thanaton.<ref name="Testing" />

==Behind the scenes==
The player can choose to let the Republic destroy the ''Carnage'' before firing the Silencer, order it to be fired right away and destroy the ''Carnage'' in a blast or give Darth Achelon time to withdraw to a safe distance first. In the latter case, Achelon would show his gratitude by not attacking Kallig<ref name="Testing" /> and later refusing to do so once again after being ordered to by Thanaton on Corellia.<ref>{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Duel|Corellia}}</ref>
